extracted.name: Peach Angel Food Cake
extracted.description: This quick and easy peach angel food cake recipe is made with a box cake mix and canned peaches, making it a perfect 2-ingredient dump-and-bake treat.
ingredient_lines: 1 (18.25 ounce) package angel food cake mix
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Combine cake mix and peaches with juice in a large bowl until well combined. Pour batter into an ungreased 10x4-inch tube pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until the top is dark golden brown and cracks feel very dry and not sticky, 37 to 47 minutes.
Cool cake in the pan, inverted onto a wire rack, empty wine bottle, or thin-necked glass bottle, this will prevent the cake from sinking.
